data.one_liner: Detects biometric authentication changes on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: This plugin checks whether the device’s biometric data (fingerprint or Face/Touch ID) has changed since the last check. It uses native APIs to compare stored biometric state and reports VALID, CHANGED, or INVALID status.
use_when: You need to react to biometric changes in your authentication flow
Your app requires a secure re‑authentication after biometric data is updated
avoid_when: You only need to perform a one‑time biometric authentication
Your app does not need to monitor biometric changes
strengths: Leverages native key invalidation and LAContext domain state
weaknesses: Android support limited to fingerprint; face unlock may not trigger key invalidation
iOS detection relies on stored domain state, may need manual persistence
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml. No extra permissions or native configuration needed.
